With a highly qualified faculty (mostly foreign PhDs), we are currently offering BS (Bachelor in Microbiology) (4-years) program. Master of Philosophy (M. Phil) (2 years) program in microbiology and Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) program in microbiology is also expected to be started soon.
